propositions: Five subprocess.run calls in gerrit_client.clone_change_ref lack timeout parameters, allowing indefinite blocking on stuck remotes or credential helpers; TimeoutExpired escapes the existing token-redaction handler, creating a credential-disclosure path.
All git calls in workspace._git and its callers are unbounded, including two network-capable fetches (fetch review and fetch tickets), with TimeoutExpired bypassing WorkspaceError conversion.
_ref_lock.py is already fully bounded with required keyword-only timeout parameter and structurally prevents unbounded calls; no edit required.
Four deferred sites in _commands/init.py and _commands/fsck_repair.py are blocked by conflicting work in task 01e8-302b-ab8f-4220 and recorded on task 983f-ee85-1e06-428e.

TimeoutExpired exceptions must be caught and converted to module-specific errors (GerritError, WorkspaceError) with operation name and bound stated, never propagating raw exception or credential-bearing URLs.
Test assertions must verify _GIT_TIMEOUT presence, all subprocess calls receive timeout kwarg, and timeout exceptions are properly converted without credential leaks.
